title: Bug: FRR failed to clean up static blackhole route when recovering from ungraceful exits.
author: BYGX-wcr
body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

Critical

### Description of the bug

We observed that FRR failed to remove stale static blackhole route when it recovered from previous ungraceful exits.

### Steps to Reproduce

On a running SONiC device, perform the following steps:
1. configure a static blackhole route: sonic-db-cli CONFIG_DB hset "STATIC_ROUTE|default|::/0" nexthop "" blackhole "true"
2. kill the FRR ungracefully (can be done via many ways): sudo kill -9 <pid-of-zebra>
3. remove the blackhole route config: sonic-db-cli CONFIG_DB del "STATIC_ROUTE|default|::/0"
4. restart the BGP container: sudo systemctl restart bgp
5. check kernel routing table: ip -6 route | grep blackhole

you will see that the route is still there :(

### Actual Behavior and Expected Behavior

The blackhole route should be removed since it is no longer in SONiC or FRR configuration

comments.author: deepak-singhal0408
comments.body:
## Root Cause Analysis

Reproduced this issue and traced the root cause.

### 1. Not blackhole-specific

This seems to affect **all** route types installed by FRR (proto 196). Both blackhole and regular nexthop static routes persist as stale after the same procedure.

### 2. Root Cause: Sweep fires before routes are processed into RIB

When zebra restarts without `-K` (graceful_restart=0), the startup sequence is:

1. `route_read()` reads kernel routes → queues them in the **metaqueue** (not directly into the RIB)
2. `zebra_main_router_started()` schedules `rib_sweep_route()` with a 0-second timer
3. Event loop starts: sweep fires immediately
4. **Problem**: The metaqueue has `ZEBRA_RIB_PROCESS_HOLD_TIME = 10ms` hold delay — routes haven't been moved from metaqueue into the RIB yet
5. Sweep walks an **empty RIB** → finds nothing → no-op
6. 10ms later, work_queue processes routes into RIB → stale routes persist forever

### 3. Reproduction (FRR 10.5.1, SONiC VS)

```
admin@sonic:~$ sonic-db-cli CONFIG_DB hset "STATIC_ROUTE|default|::/0" nexthop "" blackhole "true"
admin@sonic:~$ ip -6 route | grep blackhole
blackhole default dev lo proto 196 metric 20 pref medium

# Kill zebra ungracefully, remove config, restart
admin@sonic:~$ docker exec bgp bash -c 'kill -9 $(pidof zebra)'
admin@sonic:~$ sonic-db-cli CONFIG_DB del "STATIC_ROUTE|default|::/0"
admin@sonic:~$ sudo systemctl restart bgp

# After restart - route is stale:
admin@sonic:~$ ip -6 route | grep blackhole
blackhole default dev lo proto 196 metric 20 pref medium   ← STALE
```

### 4. Proposed Fix

Add a metaqueue drain check at the top of `rib_sweep_route()` in `zebra_rib.c`:

```c
void rib_sweep_route(struct event *t)
{
    if (zrouter.mq->size > 0) {
        event_add_timer_msec(zrouter.master, rib_sweep_route, NULL,
                             ZEBRA_RIB_PROCESS_HOLD_TIME * 2,
                             &zrouter.t_rib_sweep);
        return;
    }
    /* ... existing sweep logic ... */
}
```

This defers the sweep until the metaqueue has drained, ensuring routes are in the RIB before sweeping.

Will create a fix PR for SONiC and file an upstream FRR issue/fix as well.

linkedPullRequests.title: zebra: defer RIB sweep until metaqueue is drained
linkedPullRequests.author: deepak-singhal0408
linkedPullRequests.body:
#### What I did

SONiC-only carry patch for FRR zebra — defer RIB sweep until the metaqueue drains. Adds bounded retry logic (50 retries × 20ms = ~1s cap).

**To be dropped** when the upstream startup-ordering rework ([FRRouting/frr#21550](https://github.com/FRRouting/frr/pull/21550)) lands in a future FRR tag bump.

#### How I did it

When zebra starts without `-K` (`graceful_restart=0`), the sweep timer fires with 0-second delay but the metaqueue `work_queue` has a 10ms batching hold (`ZEBRA_RIB_PROCESS_HOLD_TIME`). This causes the sweep to walk an empty RIB and miss stale routes still queued in the metaqueue.

The patch checks `zrouter.mq->size > 0` before sweeping. If the metaqueue is non-empty, it reschedules the sweep at 2× the hold time (20ms), up to 50 retries (~1 second). After max retries, it sweeps anyway with a warning log.

#### How to verify it

1. Boot a SONiC VS image with this patch
2. Verify stale kernel routes are properly swept after startup
3. Check syslog for `RIB sweep deferred` debug messages (with `debug rib` enabled)

#### Which release branch to backport

202511, msft-202412

| `msft-202412` | [Azure/sonic-buildimage-msft#2260](https://github.com/Azure/sonic-buildimage-msft/pull/2260) | 0147 | ⏳ CI pending |

- [FRRouting/frr#21550](https://github.com/FRRouting/frr/pull/21550) — structural fix (pending merge upstream, will supersede this patch)
